summary: Bitcoin Cash hackathon with a Mainnet track (live demo, WizardConnect integration), a Media track and community awards. Prizes paid on BCH mainnet.
eligibility: Open to developers worldwide, solo or teams of 2-4; at least one team member must attend a BLAZE preparation stream.
title: BCH BLAZE 2026 Hackathon
deadlineLabel: Registration closes (timezone not stated); submissions 14-22 Nov

prize.description: US$8,000+ (25 BCH): Mainnet 1st US$3,500, 2nd US$1,500, 3rd US$750; Media US$1,000; Community Choice US$750; TokenHunt US$250.

notes: Winners announced 28 Nov. Paid in PUSD, BLISS NFTs, BCH or CashTokens.
